path.id: Look into the openings. Follow the rims. Notice how one small roll becomes a whole field.
Hollow rolls, irregular circular openings and thin folded edges.
Close-set units form a dense, honeycomb-like cluster. The oat surface is soft and slightly rough.

Thickness, folds and shadow inside each opening create the tonal variation. Extract from the noodles, avoiding the basket, sauce and background.
